findings.title: Search terms written to logs/frappe.log through a Form Dict logger
findings.evidence:
+	frappe.logger(with_more_info=True).warning("search_patients returned %s rows", len(rows))
with_more_info=True adds a SiteContextFilter that appends "Form Dict: {'family': '[REDACTED]', 'identifier': '[REDACTED]'}" to the line (frappe/utils/logger.py). Search terms are PHI (context/domain/spice-lite-glossary.md).
findings.recommendation: Delete the line. search_patients already calls log_access("search", "SL Patient", [r.name for r in rows], result_count=len(rows)), which logs document names and a count only. Add a test that asserts audit.py and api/ never call frappe.logger with with_more_info=True.

checkedClean.evidence: The diff adds no frappe.db.sql, frappe.qb or string-built filter; search_patients still uses frappe.get_list with a filters list.

limitations: Diff-only review: files outside the diff were read only where the changed code calls them.
